Clusters.description: Configures tenant clustering, which forwards the requests of each tenant to the cluster holding its slot. This section is also the YARP configuration of the clusters proxy. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/ReverseProxy/TenantClusters/.

Enabled.description: Whether this instance forwards the requests to the tenant clusters. Requires the 'RouteTemplate' route and at least one cluster. Defaults to false.

MaxIdleTime.description: The maximum idle time before a tenant running on this instance is released, e.g. '01:00:00'. When not defined, tenants are not released.

Routes.description: The YARP routes. The 'RouteTemplate' route is the catch-all route used to forward the requests.

RouteTemplate.description: The catch-all YARP route used to forward the requests. Its 'ClusterId' must reference a configured cluster, each request then being reassigned to the cluster of its tenant.

Clusters.description: The tenant clusters by identifier, which are also YARP clusters.

SlotRange.description: The inclusive minimum and maximum tenant slots of this cluster, between 0 and 16383. The ranges of different clusters must not overlap.

Destinations.description: The YARP destinations by identifier. Each destination must be able to serve the tenants of this cluster.
